observations: Three photos show a black console wrapped in clear plastic, with two black game controllers placed on top.
The console has a rectangular shape with a visible disc slot on the front, consistent with a PlayStation 4 design.
The controllers have the standard PlayStation button layout: D-pad, analog sticks, action buttons (triangle, circle, cross, square), and central PlayStation button.
The console and controllers appear to be in good physical condition, with no visible cracks or damage.
The photos are taken from slightly different angles, showing the top and front of the console and controllers.
There is a yellow sticky note on the console in photo 1 and photo 2, but the text is not legible.
Watermark 'DALLAX COMPUTERS $ GAME' is visible on all photos.
No power cord, HDMI cable, or other accessories are visible in the photos.
